fld_description: Filter id (Darwin Core parentEventID); the id part of sample_key calcofi_2022-edna:filter:<id>. An eventID is the finer sequencing-library grain (assay x PCR replicate), not the sample.
Filter collection datetime: the source's ISO 8601 local time with a UTC offset (e.g. 2022-10-13T13:50-07:00), converted to UTC by parsing the offset
CalCOFI line/station and depth label (e.g. 80.7 59.9); kept for QA, not yet matched to a station (question Q06)
Kept verbatim for QA; staging-only, not projected into core sample
One ASV (distinct sequence) in one sequencing library; join key between occurrence, dnaderiveddata and extendedmeasurementorfact; staging-only
Sequencing library: assay suffix (_DL, _MiFish) and, for D-loop, a PCR replicate (-1, -2, -3); staging-only
WoRMS LSID URN (urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:<AphiaID>), used verbatim as dataset_taxon.ds_taxa_code
AphiaID extracted from the scientificNameID LSID URN via regexp_extract('([0-9]+)$')
Sequence reads for this ASV in this library (organismQuantityType 'DNA sequence reads' on every row, asserted)
Assay code: 'D-loop' -> dloop, '12S rRNA (SSU mitochondria)' -> 12s; asserted against the library's _DL / _MiFish suffix. Becomes the suffix of measurement_type edna_reads_<assay>.
SUM of reads over the taxon's ASVs and the filter's PCR replicate libraries of one assay; obs.measurement_value for edna_reads_<assay>. A semi-quantitative signal, not abundance.
Libraries (PCR replicates) of this assay in which this filter detected the taxon; staging-only

Mapped by exact measurementType text and asserted measurementUnit (emof_type_map): ammonia, nitrate, nitrite, phosphate, silicate, chl_fluor, oxygen_mg_l, dna_concentration (per filter) and edna_reads_raw_<assay> / edna_reads_filtered_<assay> (per library, summed per assay). The other measurementTypes (FAIRe protocol text, the OTU/ASV count of question Q04) are not published.
Numeric value; asserted identical across the occurrences of its filter (per-filter types) or library (raw and filtered reads). The FAIRe terms 'missing' / 'missing: not provided' emit no row.
